title: F4 - content/model/axis-glossary.json
description: Curated. One entry per axis VARIANT, because that is the granularity a chip renders at.

efh.spec: FOUNDATION.md 2.7 lines 340-345 ('as D1 2.4 MINUS chip_suppression'), resolving to D1-reference-structure.md 2.4 lines 211-231
efh.keyOrderContract: Emit keys in propertyOrder exactly; entries[] is ordinal-sorted by (axis_key, value).

efhForbiddenProperties.entries[].chip_suppression: A3-S8 (FOUNDATION line 81 and 2.7 line 340): chip_suppression is a TOTAL FUNCTION of data/ - F3 modal_share >= 0.90, F1 axis_provenance.<key>.oxfunc_tier in {B, C}, and the vacuity rule - so it may not be frozen in content/. It is computed at build time. This is one of the three fields the T1 acceptance test (c) allow-list names.

glossary_version.description: R. Bumped on any text change; claims reference it. D1 2.4 line 218.

axis_key.description: R. Joins F3 axes[].key; must exist in F3 or the build fails.

value.description: R. Joins F3 variant value; must exist in F3 or the build fails.

chip_label.description: R. Lowercase reader-facing chip text; null means never render as a chip. A3-S2: chips render lowercase human prose, never raw machine tokens.

boundary.description: R. What the value does NOT claim. Required, never empty. D1 2.4 line 223.

gloss_basis.description: R. handbook-inferred is MANDATORY for every variant of the 7 undocumented axes and forces .chip--provisional in the Working lens (A3-S4, FOUNDATION 2.7 lines 344-345).

source_quote.description: C. Required iff gloss_basis == 'oxfunc-documented'. Verbatim doc comment.

provenance_class.description: R. Same vocabulary as F1 axis_provenance.<key>.provenance_class.

oracle_assertion.description: R, may be null. For excel-claimed only. The two false consts are const today: the five 'Verified live Excel 16.0 build 20026' phrases in OxFunc are doc-comment assertions with no witness path and no counts (D1 2.4 line 228).

chapter_anchor.description: R. The chip's link target; must resolve or the build fails. A3-S2: every chip's href must be a distinct resolved chapter_anchor, and until the anchors exist chips render as non-links.
